drug_information: CSL112 (reconstituted apoA-I [human] with phosphatidylcholine, sucrose-stabilized; lyophilized, dissolved in sterile water for injection), intravenous infusion (2-h infusion per review) of 3.4 g once weekly in the Phase 1 multiple-ascending-dose study (Gille et al. [30], NCT01281774). This row corresponds to the last infusion of the 3.4 g once-weekly regimen. Measured analyte: plasma phosphatidylcholine.
cohort_information: Phase 1 multiple-ascending-dose (MAD), double-blind (described elsewhere as adaptive, unblinded), placebo-controlled randomized study in 36 healthy volunteers randomized 3:1 to CSL112 or placebo across regimens (3.4 g once weekly, 6.8 g once weekly, 3.4 g twice weekly). Early CSL112 Phase 1 trials were performed mostly in White males (97.2%). This row corresponds to the 3.4 g once-weekly arm.
notes:
Reported as part of a t½ range statement; specific scalar explicitly tied to the 3.4 g 1-week last infusion.
Half-life note: Table 1 footnote/abbreviation list defines "t1/2 terminal elimination half-life"
